title: Eternally Wrinkled with Unappealing Drape but functional
text: Eternally Wrinkled with Unappealing Drape but functional. These do a good job of keeping out temp and light, but they drape horribly and after several weeks hanging are still wrinkled.  Would not purchase again.  Functional, but unattractive.
